what_we_know: ESPÍA identity and division of scientific/engineering responsibility are canonically documented.
PIT binding is implemented and runtime validated in SERPIENTE main according to the persisted engineering state.
A source-process health implementation exists in SERPIENTE PR #9 but is not yet part of main validation/merged state.
what_we_do_not_know: Whether the new continuity plane can be recovered by a genuinely fresh ESPÍA instance without conversational assistance.
Whether all historical scientific artifacts have been reconciled into the canonical registries.
Whether prospective predictive validity exists for the current system.
what_we_cannot_identify: Causal effects without an appropriate identification design and outcome ascertainment.
True world changes when measurement/reporting changes cannot be separated from phenomenon changes.
what_we_cannot_predict: Operationally validated future outcomes globally across regimes, populations and sources.
what_we_have_failed_to_validate: Prospective predictive validity of the integrated CeutIA + SERPIENTE system.
Operational effectiveness of early warnings and interventions.
what_requires_new_data: Genuinely future-unknown observations for prospective evaluation.
Real source-process observations for continuous acquisition validation.
Outcome ascertainment data linked to decisions and interventions.

falsification_rule: Any item in this registry may be revised only by explicit evidence and a traceable state delta; implementation existence alone does not erase a scientific limitation.
